posts.linkedin:
A single wrong price or timing message can quickly erode a small business’s trust.

Owners often juggle WhatsApp messages while serving walk‑in customers, checking a paper notebook, or recalling today’s price and opening time from memory. A café, a gym, or a clinic can send a typed reply with the wrong rate or hour, and the customer arrives expecting something different. One apology does not erase the confusion.

I create an AI chatbot that answers common customer questions automatically, without replacing every human conversation. The basic version provides 24‑hour rule‑based replies and covers the top twenty questions a business receives, while forwarding new leads to WhatsApp. The advanced version is trained on the business’s catalogue and can collect leads without manual input.

The process starts with the owner listing what the business sells and the questions customers ask most often. I then build the chatbot using those answers as its knowledge base. The owner reviews the bot, requests any changes, and only after the final version is approved does the client pay.

With the bot handling routine queries, the owner can reduce the time spent typing the same price or opening hour into a phone while attending to shoppers. Answers are available at night when the shop is closed, and repeated questions are less likely to interrupt the workday. Customers receive more consistent information, freeing mental bandwidth for tasks that grow the business.

I am happy to discuss whether this approach fits your business and to give an honest view. Payment is required only after you approve the work. If you would like to explore it, DM BOT and tell me what you sell.
posts.bluesky: Sending a customer the wrong price by mistake sticks in memory longer than the sale. A chatbot trained on your catalogue can help give consistent correct answers. DM BOT to see if it fits your business. #SmallBizIndia

The chatbot costs INR 2,999 or INR 4,999 plus INR 299 a month for maintenance, and payment happens only after you approve the work. I can explain how it would work for you. Prefer a WhatsApp chat or details here?

replies.reply: Hi, thanks for messaging. I help businesses get more direct enquiries with an AI chatbot that answers customer questions automatically. Quick question: is your main problem getting enquiries, converting Instagram followers, or managing leads?

Of course. I can send a one-page summary: what is included, timeline, and price range. Is the hesitation budget, timing, or whether it will actually bring enquiries? If budget is the concern, we can start small and expand later, and you pay only after you approve the work.
